boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Illinois State University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and supply stops in Normal with directly verified evening, overnight, or weekend late hours. Check the linked source before leaving because hours can change.

cards.title: Calzones After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 121 E. Beaufort Street in Uptown Normal
cards.notes: Walk east from campus for calzones, salads, or sides; check the linked menu before leaving because its listed hours can change.
cards.short_summary: An Uptown calzone counter with the latest verified closing time on this board.
cards.evidence_claim: The direct Normal menu identifies D.P. Dough at 121 E. Beaufort Street and lists hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Tuesday, 2 a.m. Wednesday–Thursday, and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Tuesday, 2 a.m. Wednesday–Thursday, and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; confirm before departure.

cards.title: Weekend Pizza at One
cards.subtitle: 129 E. Beaufort Street in Uptown Normal
cards.notes: Use the Beaufort Street location for a late Friday or Saturday pizza pickup; confirm hours on the restaurant page first.
cards.short_summary: A named Uptown pizza destination with documented weekend service after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Firehouse Pizza’s official locations page identifies its Uptown Normal restaurant at 129 E. Beaufort Street and lists a 1 a.m. close Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed open until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday; other nights close earlier. Confirm current hours before going.

cards.entity_name: Jimmy John's at 305 S Main Street
cards.title: One-A.M. Sandwich Pickup
cards.subtitle: 305 S. Main Street south of campus
cards.notes: Choose pickup, delivery, or the drive-through for a late sandwich run; verify the day’s hours on the location page.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street sandwich shop whose weekend hours extend past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s official store page identifies Store 414 at 305 S. Main Street and lists store, drive-through, and delivery service until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Store, drive-through, and delivery are listed until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday.

cards.title: The Three-A.M. Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: 1600 E. College Avenue in Normal
cards.notes: Plan on a vehicle or delivery for this east-side run, and recheck the official location page before heading out late.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue fast-food stop listing uniform 3 a.m. service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page identifies the restaurant at 1600 E. College Avenue and lists restaurant and drive-through hours until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are listed open until 3 a.m. every day; verify current service mode before departure.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 1527 E College Avenue
cards.title: Two-A.M. Drive-Through Tacos
cards.subtitle: 1527 E. College Avenue in Normal
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for service after the dining room closes, and check the official page before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue taco stop with late drive-through hours distinct from its lobby schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page identifies 1527 E. College Avenue and lists drive-through hours until 2 a.m. daily, while dine-in hours end earlier.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 1527 E College Avenue
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed until 2 a.m. daily; the dining room closes earlier, so confirm access mode before leaving.

cards.title: Drive-Through Until Three
cards.subtitle: 804 S. Main Street south of Illinois State
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the lobby’s 11 p.m. close, and verify the location page because overnight hours may change.
cards.short_summary: A South Main Street option where the drive-through substantially outlasts the lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official location page identifies 804 S. Main Street and lists drive-through hours from 4 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily; lobby hours end at 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed from 4 a.m. to 3 a.m. daily; the lobby closes at 11 p.m. Confirm before departure.

cards.title: Round-the-Clock Diner Stop
cards.subtitle: 1615 N. Main Street in Normal
cards.notes: Head north for a seated overnight meal or takeout; confirm the 24-hour listing on the official location page first.
cards.short_summary: Normal’s directly documented all-night diner option, with walk-in service and an all-day menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page identifies its restaurant at 1615 N. Main Street as open 24 hours every day and lists walk-ins, takeout, and service for children.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed open 24 hours daily with walk-ins and takeout; confirm the live listing before an overnight trip.

cards.title: An Eleven-P.M. Weekend Run
cards.subtitle: 202 Landmark Drive in Normal
cards.notes: Make this a vehicle-based Friday or Saturday food run, and check the official page for holiday or temporary changes.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly Landmark Drive restaurant with later weekend dining and drive-through hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Portillo’s official Normal page identifies the restaurant at 202 Landmark Drive and lists restaurant and drive-through service until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are listed until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday and 10:30 p.m. other days; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Midnight Pancakes on Weekends
cards.subtitle: 2109 E. Empire Street in Bloomington
cards.notes: Save this cross-town run for Friday or Saturday, when the official schedule extends breakfast service to midnight.
cards.short_summary: A seated breakfast destination with verified midnight closing on two weekend nights.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP’s official page identifies the restaurant at 2109 E. Empire Street in Bloomington and lists Friday and Saturday hours until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Listed open until midnight Friday and Saturday; closes at 10 p.m. on other days. Confirm before making the cross-town trip.

cards.title: The Eleven-P.M. Supply Run
cards.subtitle: 300 Greenbriar Drive in Normal
cards.notes: Use this for groceries or overlooked essentials before 11 p.m.; verify department hours separately from store hours.
cards.short_summary: A late general-supplies option when the run is about necessities rather than a restaurant meal.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart’s official page identifies Normal Supercenter #1125 at 300 Greenbriar Drive and lists the main store as open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Main store is listed open until 11 p.m. daily; pharmacy and other departments close earlier, so check the relevant service first.
